description: Source code for a ttrpc client implementation in Go, including client creation, stream management, and RPC call handling.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a client for a ttrpc server, managing streams, connection, and RPC calls.

classes.name: clientStream
classes.description: Implementation of ClientStream interface, managing individual RPC streams.

classes.name: StreamDesc
classes.description: Describes properties of a stream, such as whether it is streaming for client or server.

methods.name: WithOnClose
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be called when the client is closed.

methods.name: WithUnaryClientInterceptor
methods.description: Sets a unary client interceptor for the client.

methods.name: NewClient
methods.description: Creates a new ttrpc client with specified connection and options.

methods.name: Call
methods.description: Performs a unary RPC call to the server.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the client connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: UserOnCloseWait
methods.description: Blocks until the user's on-close callback completes.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop to receive messages and handle stream lifecycle.

methods.name: receiveLoop
methods.description: Receives messages from the channel and dispatches them to streams.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates and registers a new stream for communication.

methods.name: deleteStream
methods.description: Removes a stream from the client's registry and closes it.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Retrieves a stream by its ID.

methods.name: cleanupStreams
methods.description: Closes all active streams with an error.

methods.name: filterCloseErr
methods.description: Converts certain errors to ErrClosed for uniform handling.

methods.name: NewStream
methods.description: Creates a new RPC stream for a specific service and method.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a request and waits for a response on a new stream.
